_note: Italy has no registration tax on value or CO2. What is paid at registration is the IPT, a provincial transcription tax on engine power, set nationally by D.M. 435/1998 and raised by each province by up to 30%. Since the province is the buyer's own and we do not ask for it, the line is a range: the national rate at the bottom, the highest permitted increase at the top.

source.title: ACI — normativa IPT, D.M. 27 novembre 1998 n. 435 (aci.gov.it)
